text:
maria: Quick sync — planning a midweek "sparkline" newsletter for next Tues. Goal: promote the new benchmark report + a linked webinar sign-up. Want to test 2 subject lines and 3 segmentation branches. Who can confirm seg queries and send windows?

leo: I can take segments. Proposed: 1) Active product users (last 30d eng events), 2) Trialers who started in last 60d, 3) Dormant (60-180d no opens). Want different CTA for each.

jess: Two subject ideas to A/B: 
- "New: LLM benchmark that shows real cost savings"
- "See how teams cut inference spend (benchmark inside)"
Also preheader variants: "Top models, latency, and cost tradeoffs" vs "Benchmarks + webinar invite"

arjun: For tracking, let's standardize UTM and templates. Example: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=sparkline_midweek_v1&utm_content=cta_a`
Also recommend `X-Experiment: sparkline_subject_v1` header for internal routing.

maya: Webinar tie-in — we have a 4/8 technical briefing with the research team. For the trialers segment, the CTA should be "Get benchmark + early webinar access" to drive conversions.

eli: I'll handle send windows. Proposal: US/CA send Tues 10am PT, EU send Tues 10am GMT, APAC Wed 10am SGT. For dormant segment, delay send by 24h and use different subject line to avoid churn.

leo: Segment queries: I'll drop SQL in the doc by EOD. Need confirmation on suppression list: exclude anyone with "do-not-email" tag + unsubscribes.

jess: Creative note — hero image should be the benchmark heatmap. Two CTAs: primary "Download benchmark" (links to gated doc), secondary "Register: 4/8 briefing" (modal). For trialers, swap primary/secondary.

arjun: Can we add a light personalization token: `{{company_name}}` in subject for trialers? small lift but tested uplift.

maria: Love it. Action items: leo owns segment SQL (due EOD), eli owns send schedule & SendGrid setup (due tomorrow), jess owns creative + subject A/B files (due EOD), arjun handles UTM & headers (done after campaigns created). maya to own webinar registration page copy. I'll create the send checklist and trigger QA thread. :rocket:

marketing-bot: Reminder set — campaign preflight checklist due in 48 hours.

eli: I'll queue a dry run to staging with seed list. Tag me when creative is final.

maria: Thanks team — if anyone spots deliverability flags (spammy phrases), call it out here. Otherwise we'll roll with this plan."
